summary: The exact candidate fixes the reproduced AWQ GDN split-loader defect: AWQ qweight/qzeros/scales are bound to the tuple-aware loader, and output-packed tensors are split in packed checkpoint units. Candidate tests and independent exact target-dimension checks pass on gfx950. Full 27B generation and the reporter's CUDA sm_120 path remain unverified.

tests.command: ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-b8efd5e50c19/venv/bin/python - <<'PY' (independent base PackedvLLMParameter binding and split probe)
tests.what_was_measured: On the recorded base, qweight received tuple shard id (0,1,2) unsplit; forcing the wrapper failed because logical split sizes [16,8,24] did not match six packed columns.
At exact candidate commit: 10 loader regression and compatibility tests passed.

tests.what_was_measured: On gfx950, exact reconstruction for qweight and qzeros packed widths [256,256,768], scale widths [2048,2048,6144], plus noncontiguous shard selection.
